title: Skill types are one list shared by every department; in Zoho each department has its own skill types
label: BUG vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Setup › Customization › Skills › Skill Types · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt, dept Haytham Mohamed, Setup › Skills › Skill Types

panels.caption: TAVI: Skills › Skill Types. No department picker (1); the help text says "Every department uses the same types" (2); a new type is added for all departments (3).
Zoho: Setup › Skills › Skill Types. Department picker "Haytham Mohamed" (1); the Skill Types list shown is that department's (2); Add Skill Type sits under the selected department (3).

rows: Department selector on the Skill Types tab
A department picker at the top of the Skills page also applies to the Skill Types tab.
No department picker. The page subtitle says "Define each department's skills and skill types", but the Skill Types tab is not filtered by department.
Which skill types a department sees
Only its own skill types and their associated skills. Another department has a separate list.
One list for the whole company (General, Tech, …). The help text says "Every department uses the same types."
Adding, renaming or deleting a skill type
Add Skill Type sits under the selected department (Haytham Mohamed). Not checked: the effect on another department.
There is one list, so a type added, renamed or deleted here is the same for every department.
